283133404.description: Natural quartz crystal cluster specimen weighing 563.2 grams. The cluster features multiple transparent to translucent quartz points with hexagonal terminations growing from a shared rocky matrix with earthy brown and tan coloration. Dimensions: 5.25 x 3.75 x 3 inches. The specimen exhibits raw edges and skeletal key growth patterns typical of natural quartz formations. Crystals vary in size and clarity with minor inclusions and natural imperfections consistent with unpolished mineral specimens. The piece does not sit flat and features small crystal growths on the underside. This is a raw, unprocessed natural mineral specimen. Suitable for mineral collectors, crystal display, or decorative purposes. With the raw edge it is possible to see flaking or shedding.

283280518.description: This lot includes two raw apophyllite mineral specimens. The left specimen measures 3x2.5x1 inches and the right specimen measures 2.5x1.5x1.25 inches. Both crystals have a colorless to milky white appearance with transparent to translucent qualities and well-defined hexagonal faces. The larger cluster is roughly oval-shaped while the smaller one is more irregular. Natural matrix is present on the underside, with one piece showing greenish mineralization. The combined weight of both specimens is 232.8 grams. These specimens are in raw, unpolished condition. Due to the softer nature and raw edges of apophyllite, flaking or cracks on the edges may be present. No obvious damage is noted. Suitable for collectors, display, or metaphysical use.
